h:
这是 ComfyUI 可能的最小 T2I 工作流程，可以为 Civitai 保存足够的元数据。

让我解释一下为什么这很重要。

我们使用的存储库只有 5 星恩克乔科艾的 使用元数据保存图像去给他们一颗星星
而不是 125 星的 repo 舒适图像保护程序通过吉里斯的

首先这是使用 Nkchoco 的图像保护程序的 t2i 工作流程，非常紧凑。
这是 Giriss 工作流程的一部分。
在这变得多么混乱之后，您可能会注意到它需要一个特殊的检查点加载器，这还不是全部，您还需要更多的自定义节点，但最让我印象深刻的是您可以选择不使用与控制模型相同的数据来提供保存程序。

这似乎是为了欺骗元数据。在使用过它之后，我可以告诉你，在很多情况下，谎言比真相更容易。这让我很烦恼。

没有什么可以反对 Giriss，因为我相信他们只是做了一个对他们有意义的实现，并且适合他们在编码方面的优势。五个月的时间里，没有其他选择。所以难怪他们得到了爱情。碰巧它存在一些问题，更好的解决方案出现了，而相比之下，新节点被严重低估了。

我相信这是因为人们在为任何给定任务选择节点时倾向于关注星星而不是发布日期。包括我自己。

请在 CivitAI 社区分享此信息，任何仍在使用 Giriss 的保护程序的人都应该尝试 Nkchoco 的保护程序。它可能存在我不知道的问题，但它仍在更新，我相信它目前只是被低估了。

o.en:
This is the smallest possible T2I workflow for ComfyUI that can save with sufficient metadata for Civitai.

Let me explain why this is important.

We are using a repo with only 5 starsnkchocoai's SaveImageWithMetaDatago give them a star
Rather than the 125 star repo comfy-image-saverbygiriss's

First of all this is the t2i workflow using Nkchoco's image saver, very compact.
This is a chunk of the Giriss workflow.
After just how much more tangled this is you may notice that it requires a special checkpoint loader, that's not all, you need yet more custom nodes, but what sticks out to me most is that you could just choose to not use the same data to feed the saver as used to control the model.

This seems built to spoof metadata. Having worked with it I can tell you it makes a lie easier then the truth in a lot of cases. That bothers me.

Nothing against Giriss as I believe they just made an implementation that made sense to them and was geared to their strengths in coding. For five months there was no other option. So no wonder they got love. It just so happens that there's some problems with it, that a better solution came out, and that the new node is wildly underrated by comparison.

I believe this is because people tend to look at the stars and not the release date when choosing a node for any given task. Myself included.

Please share this around the CivitAI community, anyone still using Giriss's saver should try the saver by Nkchoco. It may have issues I don't know about but it's still being updated and I believe it's just underrated at the moment.
